summary: A clickable control that triggers an action.
purpose: Use for any discrete action. Reach for it instead of a styled div or a raw MUI Button so token discipline and the accessibility floor hold.

anatomy.description: The pressable surface; carries the variant color and radius.
The action text; a verb-first phrase.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight and intent of the action.

variants.name: primary
variants.whenToUse: The single main action on a surface.

variants.name: secondary
variants.whenToUse: Secondary actions that sit beside a primary, and actions inside cards.

variants.name: ghost
variants.description: No border or fill until hover.
variants.whenToUse: Low-emphasis actions like nav or Back.

variants.name: danger
variants.whenToUse: Destructive actions the user should pause on.

whenToUse: Triggering an action such as submit, open, or navigate.
The main call to action on a screen, as a single primary.

whenNotToUse.scenario: Navigating to another page as plain inline text

do: Keep one primary button per surface.
Use a verb-first label such as Unmess Me.
Give an icon-only button an aria-label.
dont: Stack multiple primary buttons on one screen.
Hardcode a color; the variant sets it from tokens.

keyboard: Enter and Space activate the button.
accessibility.contrast: Label-to-fill contrast holds at least 4.5:1 in every variant.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus ring on keyboard focus.

related.whenToChoose: Use Tag for a non-action label; Button is for actions.
